verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents its own APIs for programmatically managing connections, transformations and other features, plus audit-log access. That allows headless, non-UI operation an automation pipeline could call. Profiles are declared in version-controlled YAML, which fits code-driven workflows. However, nothing in the evidence documents a CLI, CI integration, or a headless/CI-specific workflow, so the depth of CI support is unproven. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/CD integration (e.g. pipeline or GitHub Actions usage), a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
